newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 19 as Panamaxes continue in good demand.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 19 as Panamaxes continue in good demand.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index rose 19 points on Thursday to 1406 as Panamax rates continued to improve on the strength of grain enquiry in the Atlantic and minerals in the Pacific.
The Pacific Handy Index was up two to 1008.
At 1300 GMT BIFFEX was 45 to 15 points higher as the market continued to reflect increased optimism in the underlying market for February. Turnover totalled 213 lots.
